en.83509db8: This medicine is used as adjuvant treatment for hair loss.
en.1ced5600: Adults take 1 tablet per 1 dose, 3 times a day.
en.314015eb: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are under 19 years of age, do not have hair loss (alopecia), or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

en.2864265e: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines.
en.d02b6027: Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines.
en.ece8bac7: To avoid drug interactions, tell your doctor or pharmacist about your recent treatments.
en.ab4c9874: If skin allergic reactions such as redness (erythema) or hives occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
